typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFolder as string (),
	ExportFile as string (),
	FileMarket as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	FileType as string (),
	GRGR_CK as integer (),
	GRGR_CKs as string (),
	ReportDate as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		FILE_MARKET as string,
		GRGR_CK as long,
		FILE_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT GRGR_CK,FILE_MARKET,FILE_TYPE FROM EXTRACT.HUMANARC_FILE_DATA_STAGING ORDER BY GRGR_CK,FILE_TYPE',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> DistinctGRGRCKandMarketName
DistinctGRGRCKandMarketName sink(input(
		FILE_MARKET as string,
		GRGR_CK as long,
		FILE_TYPE as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		FILE_MARKET,
		GRGR_CK,
		FILE_TYPE)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderRecordsetDestination
